text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus put on a spectacular run and 
claimed a magnificent victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Hishi Akebono also ran in a 
different race, achieving the remarkable 
feat of winning in Japanese record time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The action actor watched the duo's feats 
from America. The film director watching 
alongside him also took interest in the 
two as an odd-couple Umamusume duo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next is the "Sprinters Stakes." Hishi 
Akebono and Biko Pegasus finally stand 
side-by-side on the same track as rivals.
